game_title: Comprehension Lab – Fallen Statue Garden Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform moon crystals.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform moon crystals. Each round, stone sentinels strike the ancient lock, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the ancient lock from stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden: keep the lab_output meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lab_output drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while lab_output > 0.
